name: Thermal-magnetic circuit breaker
summary: A thermal-magnetic breaker combines overload response with a magnetic response to high current.
description: A thermal-magnetic breaker combines overload response with a magnetic response to high current. Its functional annotation helps distinguish the trip mechanism from an electronic trip unit.
readingNotes: A curve designation alone does not state every operating limit or breaking rating.
